reviews.text:
From the moment I reached out to Montreal Canine Center two months ago, the support has been incredible. Their responsiveness, genuine care and willingness to answer questions make you feel like you’re talking to a friend, not a business.

We’re committed to raising a happy, well-behaved and obedient dog, and they’ve given us the tools and confidence to make that happen. Their recommendations are honest and thoughtful, and they never make you feel pressured — they simply help you understand what your dog needs and what will set you up for success.

We’ve been working with Mia, and she is exceptional. She’s structured, knowledgeable and so good at teaching us what to do at home. But what really gets me is the bond she has built with our pup. He absolutely loves her and is so eager to learn. Watching her teach him a new trick in minutes is pretty amazing!

The results we’ve seen already have been incredibly encouraging, and we’re excited to keep putting in the work.

Montreal Canine Center truly makes you feel like part of a family. If you’re looking for a balanced, knowledgeable and genuinely caring team that produces results, look no further.

Thank you, Mia (🥰) and Nick, for your patience, dedication and genuine love for what you do. We couldn’t be happier to have you guiding us on this journey. ❤️🐾

I had an excellent experience with MTL Training and couldn’t be happier with the service. Nick was amazing—very knowledgeable, patient, and easy to communicate with throughout the process. He took the time to understand my dog and explain everything clearly.

What impressed me the most was how quickly I saw improvements in my dog’s behavior, even after the very first appointment. The results were noticeable and encouraging right away. I would highly recommend MTL Training to anyone looking for high-quality, effective dog training.
Nick is an excellent dog trainer and very humane. Thank you for your services

No complaints on my end he's very loyal, honest, trustworthy clear and straight to the point person my dog only had one accident since he been home and I am much appreciated for that but I will be passing his number around for people who have dogs that need to be trained

Had a great consultation with Tyson yesterday looking forward to more classes for Cairo, our 8 month old great pyr. It was amazing to see the theory in action with immediate results. Very knowledgeable, approachable, and all around great experience.

I highly recommend MTL Canine Training!

My German Shepherd, Mayson, used to be reactive toward other dogs, and thanks to Nick’s incredible guidance, everything has changed. We started with a few private sessions and were then able to transition into group classes, which was a huge milestone for us.
Nick is not only extremely talented, but also patient, open-minded, and always available to help. His approach made such a difference—not just for Mayson, but for me as well. I now feel much more confident and equipped with the right tools and understanding to continue supporting my dog.
Mayson is now so much more balanced, and I’m truly grateful for all the progress we’ve made.

I recently got a Doberman puppy and reached out to Montreal Canine Training for guidance.  Nick has been exceptional! He’s extremely  knowledgeable in the field and has a very patient approach which I really appreciate. Having implemented his techniques, I started seeing results from day one. So happy that I have such a reliable resource for everything dog related 🙌🏻Highly recommended!
Amazing experience, would recommend to everyone. Thank you so much

Being first time large breed owners, we were nervous and clueless with  our Rottweiler.  But Jess did such an great job with Bella since day one.  Her cool and calm nature helped us stay focused. She provided us with plenty of tips, tricks and exercices. She has provided us with training at their facility as well as at our home.  We highly recommend Jess and her expertise. Thank you so much!!

I did a few training sessions with Tyson and Nick for my 4-year-old Australian Shepherd, who was extremely stubborn and reactive. They gave me all the right tools to work through her reactivity and properly socialize her in public settings so we can travel with her. We’ve seen a huge improvement and are really happy with the progress. We’ll continue training with her daily and will definitely be back when we’re ready to work on her e-collar training 🙂

Highly recommend working with them and especially Tyson if you have a working breed!!

I had been searching for a dog training apprenticeship in Montréal for a long time. However, before finding Nick's apprenticeship program, no other program had enticed me enough to partake!

After seeing Nick and the work that he does with the dogs, I saw that he really had a good understanding of them and what it takes to shape/change their behaviours. His apprenticeship program covers a lot of important information and I am incredibly grateful that I've completed it. After only one week into his apprenticeship program, I was already able to start applying concepts that he taught me, with the dogs that I work with.

Nick helps people and their dogs live securely in harmony. He understands that different dogs need different approaches and always approaches & adjusts to them accordingly. Which is so important because just like we humans do not all share the same personalities and experiences, dogs are individuals aswell. Nick strives to help people build engagement & relationships with their dogs.

Thanks Nick!

Tyson has been an amazing trainer for Cosmo. We saw improvements starting from the consultation session, especially with crate training — we went from moments of frustration to having a clear plan and real progress right away. We’ve improved session after session, and we always leave with practical, doable steps to work on at home.

My adolescent Australian Shepherd gets very excited around other dogs and people, and Tyson has helped us build better engagement, improve our heel, and strengthen crate training — but most importantly, he shares real-life, practical tips to channel Cosmo’s energy in a positive way.

His attention to detail and the way he tailors everything to our specific situation is what convinced me to book private lessons with him. Highly recommend!
We worked with Jess for 5 sessions. She was very clear with her explanations, very knowledgeable and easy to work with! Would recommend forsure !

Nick has been an amazing trainer, he helped us through our dogs reactivity and the progress we’ve seen is beyond what we ever thought would be possible. Our Berger malinois has improved SO MUCH thanks to nicks knowledge and ability to tailor training to our dogs needs. I recommend Montreal canine academy without hesitation!

Jess has solid foundations in dog training and offers thorough guidance when it comes to canine behavioural management. Her calm disposition and no nonsense approach to training has given us the basis with which to acclimatize our puppy to city life and get her comfortable with uncomfortable situations. Her training regimen has given us the confidence to lead our dog and has given our dog the confidence to let us lead. The value of strong leadership and actualizing our dog’s potential is priceless and we are grateful to have her along for this journey.
Thank you also to entire Montréal Canine Training team for being there every step of the way!

We thoroughly enjoyed our experience with Montréal Canin. We worked on our dog's reactivity. Tyson was a wonderful discovery as a dog trainer; he guided us in developing our commitment with his very clear instructions and practices, which made us feel confident. We loved experiencing the training in everyday situations, and our dog made fantastic progress. It was very enjoyable, and we looked forward to each session to continue our dog's development. We are very happy with the results and are continuing to work with our dog; it's so encouraging to see the progress.

We are so glad we discovered Montréal Canin. A huge thank you to our exceptional trainer, Tyson.

I’ve been working with Tyson at Montreal Canine Training for our dog’s reactivity and over-excitement, and the results have been incredible.
After trying several other trainers with no progress, Tyson was the first person who truly made a real difference. He gives clear, practical advices that are easy to apply in everyday life, and we’ve seen steady progress every single week.
My dog is now calmer and more focused during the walks!
I highly recommend Tyson to anyone looking for real results with their dog. An amazing trainer!

We highly recommend Montreal Canine Training!  We had a great experience with private classes with Nick for our 1 year old Lab/GSD, Luna.   Walking her now is night and day, she has a nice “heel” and is so much more engaged with us. We will continue the training to keep working on her jumping and recall, can’t wait!! Thanks Nick!
Huge thanks to Shanya for all her advices. If you apply everything they teach you at home, you’ll see a big difference ! Great experience. My dog is behaving so much better now.

I took some private classes with Nick to help with my reactive GSD. Nick is very knowledgeable, calm and a professional trainer. We worked on engagement and he showed me how to properly handle stressful situations. Can’t wait to continue training with him and looking forward to the group reactivity classes.

We owe so much thanks to the team at MTL Canine Training.  We began with private lessons with Nick for our German Shepherd, Vanta.  We then registered her for the day training program, and have attended group classes.  When we leave her for the day training program, it is so nice to know that she is in the hands of excellent trainers who know that they are doing, and who adore dogs.  Whether she is with Nick, Shanya, Tyson, or Jess, she is is great hands.  It is thanks to Nick and his team that we are able to have such a great life with our German Shepherd. I actually never knew how sweet German Shepherds can be, because I had always been exposed to those who were not well-trained. We absolutely found the best training facility ever!  Everyone with a dog needs to check them out.

We started taking classes with Montreal Canine a few months and luckily got Tyson as our trainer. He helped us build a strong relationship with our puppy by guiding us each step of the way. He created structured sessions and encouraged questions. He was also available out of classes if needed.
Great trainer!

We had a great experience with Jess! We adopted a one year old small mixed race and we received great training from Jess, both our dog and us! Jess has a lot of different approaches and we tested different ways until we found the right ones. We really appreciate her availability to answer questions and patience. It made a huge difference and now we are very comfortable walking our dog anywhere.

MTL Canine Training is awesome! Nick and his team are super knowledgeable, and they really helped us out. Nick's private classes fixed his leash reactivity, resource guarding, and crate training. Jessica's reactivity class with Tyson was also amazing for my reactive beagle. He used to bark and lunge at other dogs,  but now we can actually walk him and go places! I totally recommend MTL Canine Training if you need help, especially if your dog is reactive. They really know their stuff, and their Instagram shows it.

Tyson is a fantastic trainer. He’s very knowledgeable and always provided us with solutions to our very anxious and fearful 5 years old Jack.
After our 2nd private session we saw improvements in Jack which I never thought possible. Our dog walks are now more enjoyable and he’s not reacting to other dogs as much. We are looking forward to our upcoming group session which we know will help Jack even more.
We’ve tried many trainers before to no avail. We strongly recommend Tyson at Montreal Canine Training.

Can’t be happier with the progress we made with Bruno, our unhinged wiener dog! We never thought he could behave in a group class setting, but with proper guidance it is very possible! Thanks to Shanya and her support. Finally WE are training Bruno, and not the other way around😅 …

This was my first experience with a dog trainer and Nick exceeded my expectations.
After just one private session I noticed immediate improvement with my almost 6 year old toy poodle, Gigi. Gigi’s separation anxiety was getting worse and it led to bad habits/behaviour.
Nick is very knowledgeable. He provides clear instructions — his training techniques are easy to understand and to implement when alone. In just a few sessions, there has been significant improvement in Gigi’s behaviour; he’s more calm and obedient.
I look forward to continuing to work with Nick. I highly recommend Montreal Canine Training!

We did private reactivity training with our golden retriever with Jessica. Jessica was amazing from day one, she has an incredible amount of knowledge and she knows what she is doing. We took 5 sessions but after just three of them, there was a huge change in our dog’s reactivity. I recommend Jessica to anyone who is dealing with a reactive dog, she is amazing!

I'm so glad an Instagram Reel about one of your reactive dogs popped up on my feed this winter! Seeing the training gave me the hope and courage to keep working with Thor. I'm so happy I found the energy and motivation to come see you.
Nick is incredible! After just a few sessions—even after the first one—I've made more progress than ever before. I'd been struggling with Thor's reactivity for almost three years, and now I see that all the hard work has paid off. I can finally enjoy a peaceful walk with Thor, and it's so precious. I've never enjoyed our walks as much as I do now.
Of all the dog trainers I've seen, Nick was the only one who truly got through to me. He explained exactly how to behave and what to do with Thor, and he gave me the right tools, like the correct collar. We'll definitely be continuing our training, and I'm already recommending your school to other owners who are struggling with their dogs' reactivity.
To anyone out there, I promise you're not alone and it will get better with Montreal Canine Training.

Customer service is good but i felt robbed after a ~130$ evaluation session where i did not learn anything new. I wish I had known it was an entry fee to their other services. I feel this could have been done through the phone under 20min instead of 1h.

Jessica was fantastic! She was incredibly helpful, knowledgeable and patient with our dog. Nova had issues with reactivity toward other dogs, and Jessica provided practical strategies and support that made a real difference. Her guidance was clear, informative, and tailored to Nova's needs, which helped us see noticeable improvement. We really appreciated her professionalism and the genuine care she showed.Highly recommend her!

We did 1-1 training with Tyson and saw incredible improvement in our 3 year old cockapoo. Tyson was extremely knowledgeable, took his time teaching Achilles and us how to be better and ultimately deepened our relationship with our dog. Thanks again Tyson, you are the best!

Jesica is an amazing dog trainer who truly cares about the dogs she works with. Even when my dog hit a roadblock, she took the time and effort to work through it with her. I couldn’t have found a better trainer — I’m so grateful for her help and highly recommend her to anyone looking for real results and genuine care. Walks now are so much easier and are enjoyable!!

We adopted Bentley 3 years ago. We are his fourth home. Poor thing was so anxious and reactive out side of our home, most especially on a leash. In fact, he was uncontrollable at times which made walking such a challenge and unsafe. All this changed when we began working with Shanya. She introduced a system of connection and engagement for us to incorporate and step by step Bentley has become a new dog. It’s amazing to see the difference. We can now enjoy our outdoor adventures and feel better equipped to guide him through stressful situations that he perceives. We are so grateful for her support and highly recommend Montreal Canine Training!
Many thanks to Jess for her knowledge, expertise, patience, and tips and tricks with our pup Sydney (and us)

A heartfelt thank you to Jessica for being an incredible trainer to our 3-year-old goldendoodle, Ollie. From the very beginning, her patience, knowledge, and genuine care made all the difference. Before starting our sessions, walks with Ollie were a challenge. His lack of engagement made even short outings feel overwhelming. But with Jessica’s guidance, we gained the tools and confidence to turn those walks into something we now all enjoy.

One of our biggest breakthroughs came earlier this month during a visit to the vet for a blood test. These visits used to be a major source of anxiety for Ollie, but thanks to the trust-building techniques Jessica taught us, he was able to stay calm and composed; he knew we were right there with him.

We’re so grateful for the foundation Jessica helped us build, and we’re excited to continue learning through the amazing classes offered by Canine Training. Most of all, we’re thrilled to keep strengthening our bond with Ollie.

I walked in completely discouraged and exhausted with a chaotic high-energy English Setter puppy, and by the 5th session, walked out with a well-behaved (still high-driven) puppy who now *walks* on a leash, respects boundaries and stays engaged. I truly recommend Jessica as she has really provided the tools for puppy training!

Tyson is absolutely amazing! We brought our Australian Shepherd, Mocha, to him for private lessons, and the transformation has been incredible. Mocha was anxious and reactive, and we were feeling pretty overwhelmed. From the very first session, Tyson made us feel supported and hopeful.

He gave us practical tools and advice, but more importantly, he helped us understand Mocha better and build her confidence. Learning to read her body language was a game-changer.

Thanks to Tyson, we feel so much more connected to Mocha, and she's thriving. We can't recommend him enough!

I saw a huge difference in my 1-year-old rescue, Cairo, since training with Shanya. We mainly worked on engagement and reactivity. The private and group classes have both been so helpful in different ways. Shanya is very knowledgeable, attentive, and encouraging.

She helped me understand my dog and build our relationship. Cairo can now focus his energy on positive training and activities, which used to feel impossible. I feel so much more confident facing future challenges with him.

Looking forward to starting level 2 group classes!

I had five sessions with Shanya and I cannot recommend her and MTL Canine enough.
She really understood my dog's personality, and the sessions were an eye opening. Knowing how to deal with my dog's emotions (reactive) and trying to have him to be calm and ignore his surroundings is a game changer. Those sessions were definitely more a lesson for me than for my dog. And now I have the tools to keep on training him. It's all about engagement 🥰🐾
Thank you so much!

"My chopper has made amazing progress thanks to Tyson! He's incredibly professional, always prioritizes safety, and my dog liking very much as well and he truly knows how to connect with dogs. I have seen a huge improvement, and I highly recommend him!"
We are looking forward to another class.

-CHOPPER 🐕

We had an incredible experience working with Tyson to help our reactive dog, Django. From the very beginning, he showed patience and empathy—not just toward our dog, but toward us as well. He understands the emotional toll that living with a reactive dog can take, and that compassion made all the difference.

The training environment was always clean, controlled, and most importantly, safe. That was a huge relief for us, as we were very anxious about unexpected encounters with other dogs. Tyson made sure everything was set up to support Django’s success, and that gave us peace of mind.

Even after the evaluation session with Nick, we noticed a shift in Django’s behaviour. The instructions from Nick and Tyson were clear, the techniques were easy to follow, and the homework was both manageable and effective. We always felt supported and never overwhelmed.

Thanks to Tyson and Nick, we feel hopeful and empowered again. If you're looking for a trainer who combines deep knowledge with genuine care, we can't recommend them highly enough!

I had a great experience training my golden doodle Bailey with Tyson. In just three session I saw a drastic improvement in Bailey. Tyson was attentive to mine and my dogs needs and tailored the training accordingly. He gave me tips and was available to message even outside training sessions. We were also able to work on Bailey’s energy with his own dogs which is not always available in individual courses elsewhere. I would highly recommend :)

It was our first time of training with our reactive golden retriever. We had a problems, that we couldn’t change. Jessica made a magic! We saw the progress from our first private class. Now we have more understanding how to walk and  react in different situations. We feel that we finally found this connection and understanding with our dog. Our walks are structured and  full of engagement exercises. Thank you for this experience!

We had an amazing experience with Nick & the staff at Montreal Canine Training! From the very beginning, they were incredibly detailed, patient, and professional. Our Belgian Malinois is now exceptionally well-trained, thanks to their expertise and dedication. The owner and staff deserve the highest praise for their knowledge, kindness, and commitment to both pets and their owners. We highly recommend them to anyone looking for top-tier dog training!

Montreal Canine Training is amazing! This is the second time I've used their services, and they are by far the most knowledgeable. Right now, I'm training my puppy, Bella, with Tyson, and he’s been incredibly helpful with all his tips and insights. He’s always quick to respond to my messages, which I really appreciate. I highly recommend Montreal Canine Training and Tyson!

Took my 5 month old Borzoï for reactivity training with Jessica, and it was such a wonderful experience. We saw improvements over the three classes we had and would absolutely recommend it to anyone who's been thinking about some doggie training classes :)

We were feeling completely discouraged with our two dogs, as things had become so chaotic. They weren’t listening to us at all, and our walks were a nightmare. That all changed when we started working with Nick! We did 5 classes with him, and it made such a difference. Our walks are now smooth and enjoyable, and the best part is that our dogs actually listen to us in the house—a miracle! Nick was so patient, knowledgeable, and really helped us understand how to communicate better with our dogs. We can’t recommend him enough! If you're struggling like we were, Nick is definitely the one to call!

I have nothing but praise for Nick and his entire team.

I have a very reactive dog, and walks had become a nightmare. Since starting classes with Nick and the "training day care" program, I've seen tremendous progress in her reactivity and engagement. Walks are much more peaceful, and I find it easier to control her.

I highly recommend Nick and his entire team. Their professionalism and expertise are impeccable.

Had a great experience working with Nick with my 1 year old american bully who her previous owners hadnt really done any sort of training with her. She’s getting better every day with loose leash walking, engagement and her reactivity. She adores the team and the doggy daycare also. I recommend them 100%!

Working with Nick was great for us and our dog Luisa. We learned how to develop the relationship and communication with her. At one point I thought she would be untrainable, but after one lesson only, I could already see the difference. After 5 private classes, Luisa’s attention and reactivity got so much better. We will continue with other type of classes this year. Nick is very passionate about his work, super calm and professional. We recommend 100% !

Working with Shanya has really helped build my relationship with Henry! We worked on Henry's reactivity and anxiety, and during the process, I was able to learn how to handle him in certain situations. Since training with Shanya and participating in group classes, I've noticed that Henry has adapted well to new environments, making our walks much more enjoyable! I look forward to continue his training journey!

We’re so happy with the results so far! Honestly, we never believed our high-prey-drive GSP could ever walk calmly on a leash—but Nick proved us wrong. His natural ability with dogs is incredible, and it’s clear he truly understands them on a deep level.

Nick’s patience and skill have made such a difference, and we’re seeing progress we didn’t think was possible. We couldn’t recommend him enough to anyone struggling with challenging dog behaviors. Thank you Nick!

We brought our 6-month-old German Shepherd mix to Montreal Canine Training for private training with Shanya, and we were amazed by the results! Even within the first few sessions, we noticed a significant improvement in her behavior.

After the private training, we enrolled her in the private daycare program, where she learned how to settle herself in a crate with other dogs around and not be disruptive. This training carried over to home life, and her behavior in the crate improved dramatically.

We also participated in the reactivity courses with Nick, which were a game-changer. These sessions helped us, as owners, better understand how to navigate her excitement around other dogs, making walks and social interactions so much more manageable.

We’re now continuing with private courses to keep improving as dog parents and to ensure we’re providing her with the best resources for success. Nick and the team at Montreal Canine Training is knowledgeable, patient, and truly dedicated to helping dogs and their owners. We couldn’t recommend them enough!

We saw 2 previous trainers to help our dog, Archie, with his on-leash reactivity. He would make some progress, and then plateau or regress. Since starting with Nick, we have seen nothing but progress with Archie. Nick has taught us what we need to know to help Archie overcome his fears, not avoid them. Nick answered all our questions without judgement and made us feel seen and confident. We did a few private lessons, and then moved on to group classes, which we continue to attend. I never imagined Archie being able to cope in a group class, but he thrives in the pack walks thanks to Nick and his guidance. Thank you, Nick :)

From our first meeting with Nick, we felt completely at ease and confident in his ability to help us with Millie, our Doberman puppy.

Knowing he has a Doberman himself made us feel understood, and his guidance was incredibly reassuring, especially when we were overwhelmed by Millie’s tornado-like behavior. Hearing that his dog went through similar phases gave us a sense of understanding and hope for the future.

The combination of private classes, reactive group classes, and the day training program made such a big difference—not just for Millie, but for us as well. Nick’s calm and patient approach, paired with his deep knowledge, made everything feel manageable.

Every trainer we interacted with, whether during group classes or the day training program, was also amazing and brought so much to Millie’s progress.

Life with Millie is so much more peaceful and fun with everything we’ve learned. We’re really grateful for all their help and would recommend them without hesitation!
Nick was a game-changer for us and our 7 year old dog! He focused on building engagement as a long-term solution to reactivity, which was exactly what we needed. …

I very highly recommend private training with Shanya. She really helped me and my Siberian Husky, King, learn how to trust each other. It has always been so difficult for me since King is so high-energy and reactive. Shanya took the time to …

Great experience so far with Shanya, Gwada has learnt a lot in a few classes and I did too on how to better interact and understand her! Definitely looking fwd to the future classes and give the help Gwada deserves for her reactivity.

Shanya has been such an incredible help with our reactive pup, he's learned to calm down and be more focused. I was at my wit's end before coming to MTL Canine. She taught me what to do in different situations and environments. Thank you so much Shanya 😁 …

We brought in our 1year old wiener dog who is a rescue and was highly reactive and insecure, making it impossible to have people over at home. We brought him to Shayna and in 7 weeks of classes we noticed a HUGE difference and improvement with his insecurities and reactivity! I couldn’t recommend it more!

10/10 highly recommend!! Nick is by far the best trainer i've ever had. I have quite the reactive Belgian Malinois and the transformation within only 3 months has been unbelievable. I never thought we would be able to take a walk in the …

I highly recommend taking private classes with Nick ! He tailored his approach to fit my dog's personality and needs , and was able to see amazing progress in just a few classes. The training methods were positive and effective , making the …

We’ve come to Nick to help us with some reactivity and engagement issue. We have a 1 year old Akita which is not an easy breed to deal with. Nick was able to adapt to Kobe and find a way to help him quickly with his reactivity. After just 4 …
